About

00:00 — 03:40
Kyler TaySingapore

"I'm a passionate Mass Communication student who lives for radio, podcasts and telling stories on screen."

I’m happiest in a team, making something from nothing, from the first line of the script to the final cut. I’m always up for learning a new tool or format, and I like it best when things move fast and everyone’s bringing ideas.

Where I'm headed

Social media and radio are where I want to end up. I want to make podcasts, radio segments and short videos that people actually stop for. Until then I’m saying yes to every production role I can, from scripting to producing to coordinating on set, and learning what makes a story land with an audience.
